substantive_reconstruction.rotation_and_inverse: Write q=sum_r bit_r 2^(-r). Rotations Ry(2pi 2^(-r)) controlled on the corresponding work bit commute, so their product has first column(cos(pi q),sin(pi q)). This matches the source's most-to-least-significant controls and half-angle convention. In order(S,W,T), B loads q_t without changing t, CR changes only S, and B† returns |q_t,t> to |0,t> in both signal branches. Linearity gives sum_t c_t|v_t,0,t>, preserving signs and label phases. Nonnegative sine equals sqrt(1-a_t²), including q0. The clean zero-signal block is diagonal D_a on the combined retained index, not the original full matrix A; the other signal block is D_b.
substantive_reconstruction.precision_and_success: The exact output is for a_t=cos(pi q_t). Generic real access and exact arccos arithmetic are not inferred from finite output length. The conditional error bounds follow from cosine and unit-circle vector Lipschitz constants pi; converting input/arithmetic errors into angle error is separate, especially near arccos endpoints. Signal-zero probability is sum_t rho_tt a_t², with normalized accepted index state D_a rho D_a†/p only for p>0. A rounded q0 may produce a1 despite strict original max norm, whereas q1 is excluded by the fixed-point range; d0 has only the empty zero record.
substantive_reconstruction.partial_trace_reconstruction: Before cleanup the density contains rho_ts |v_t><v_s| tensor |q_t><q_s| tensor |t><s|. Tracing W inserts the Kronecker delta for equal bit strings, exactly the orthogonal angle-class dephasing on the joint S,T state. It does not remove coherence within one equal-record class. Tracing T then kills t!=s regardless of cleanup, leaving the same sum_t rho_tt |v_t><v_t| for S. Additional local index dephasing or discarding cannot change that marginal. On one basis input signal/work are a product, so the signal remains pure; distinct unused records and already-incoherent inputs are not evidence of new decoherence.
substantive_reconstruction.signed_witness: For d2 choose two populated indices with q1/4,3/4 and actual allowed real entries plus/minus1/sqrt2. The corresponding v vectors are plus=(0+1)/sqrt2 and minus=(-0+1)/sqrt2. With equal coherent index amplitudes, clean signal-zero projection has index(t-s)/sqrt2; work trace yields its incoherent equal mixture. The joint test signal0,index-minus therefore has probability1/2 clean versus1/4 dirty, although both signal marginals are I/2. These are valid index-dependent rounded records with original max norm below1, and the calculation uses the negative amplitude rather than replacing it by a norm.
substantive_reconstruction.projection_and_limits: Without B†, projection onto the SAME S0,W0 flag inserts 1_(q_t=0), so both witness entries have zero block instead of D_a. Partial trace is a channel, with accepted subchannel D_a(sum_q Q_q rho Q_q)D_a†, not a unitary matrix entry. B† is sufficient cleanup, not a uniquely necessary gate; a W-only unitary cannot send two orthogonal records to one zero state. The four rubric criteria and all five steps correctly distinguish these interfaces. One B, one B† and d ideal controlled rotations are a scoped count, not total arithmetic or compiled gate complexity; all actual scratch must be included and restored. The source's omitted-work convention does not authorize ignoring it. Shared projection bookkeeping with206 is a submechanism, not target equivalence or global deduplication.
